blocks.title: On-demand access
blocks.text: On-demand access ka matlab computing wasail zaroorat par, lambi tayyari ke baghair, istemal karna hai, jaise kuan khodne ki bajaye nalka kholna.
School project ke liye achanak zyada storage chahne wala student cloud provider se foran kiraye par le kar istemal shuru kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Elasticity aur on-demand access mein farq bataiye (short question 9).
blocks.explanation: On-demand access maangne par foran wasail haasil aur istemal karna hai; elasticity nizam ka asal waqt ki talab ke mutabiq wasail khud kam zyada karna hai ta ke kaarkardagi aur laagat theek rahe.

items: On-demand: maangne par foran wasail. Elasticity: talab ke mutabiq khud-kaar tabdeeli.
